summary: Tested Enhanced Embed Code page (3 integration methods + CSS import) and Bulk Delete for Knowledge Sources. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all features working: method tabs (Popup/Inline/Fullpage), code snippets with Copy buttons, CSS URL input/save, CSS Variables Reference toggle, Live Preview, Direct URLs, and Knowledge Base bulk action bar with Delete button.

issues: Console warning: 'cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production' - appears in widget iframe preview

critical_code_review_comments: EmbedCode.js is well-structured with clear separation of concerns (CodeBlock component, METHOD_TABS config, getSnippets function)
The embed.js endpoint correctly handles all 3 modes (popup, inline, fullpage) with appropriate DOM manipulation
Bulk delete endpoint properly handles both 'source' and 'group' types with fallback to URL matching for legacy sources
ChatWidget.js correctly injects custom CSS stylesheet via link element and cleans up on unmount
seed_data_creation: Test FAQs created and deleted during bulk delete tests (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Embed Code page routes are at /admin/embed (not /embed-code). Knowledge Base is at /admin/knowledge. The embed config endpoints are: GET /api/embed/config/{id} (public), PUT /api/admin/embed-config (auth+instance required), GET /api/embed.js?instance=X&mode=Y (public). Bulk delete is POST /api/knowledge/sources/bulk-delete with items array containing {type: 'source'|'group', id: string}.
